The Zurn Elkay Supply Chain Internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic manufacturing and distribution environment. Interns will develop technical, business, and leadership skills while supporting key supply chain and operations initiatives. This role provides exposure to procurement, inventory management, supplier relations, analytics, and continuous improvement projects.

The Supply Chain Intern will work closely with Supply Chain and Operations leaders to support daily business activities, analyze operational data, identify process improvements, and contribute to projects that drive efficiency and cost savings across the organization.

As a part of the intern program, you will have the opportunity to take advantage of the following:

• Coaching and Mentoring – Interns participate in a structured onboarding program designed to introduce Zurn Elkay's culture, values, and business operations while receiving ongoing coaching and performance feedback.
• Real Work Experience – This internship provides meaningful project work and business exposure. Interns will contribute directly to operational initiatives, analyze data, present recommendations, and support continuous improvement efforts that impact the organization.
